seo.symptomsTitle: Do you recognize these anxiety symptoms?

symptoms.0: Shortness of breath or choking sensation
symptoms.10: Fear of dying or going crazy

seo.explanation: During an anxiety crisis, we tend to hyperventilate. The 4-7-8 technique and diaphragmatic breathing lengthen the exhalation, sending a physical signal to your vagus nerve to reduce your heart rate. The American Institute of Stress confirms that 3 minutes of deep breathing significantly reduces cortisol.

footer.disclaimer: Breathing exercises are complementary techniques for stress and anxiety management. They do not replace professional medical diagnosis or treatment. legal.privacyIntro: At BreathCalm, your peace of mind is our priority. This includes how we handle your information.
legal.dataCollectionBody: We only collect your email address if you choose to subscribe to our newsletter. Additionally, we save your breathing statistics (duration and technique) locally in your browser so you can see your progress.
legal.dataUsageTitle: How do we use your data?
legal.dataUsagePoint1: Your email is used to send you calm guides and updates.
legal.dataUsagePoint2: Your local statistics do not leave your device.
legal.dataUsagePoint3: We use anonymous analysis tools to improve the application.
legal.thirdPartyBody: We use Loops for email delivery and Vercel for hosting. Both comply with high security and privacy standards.
legal.contactBody: If you have questions about your privacy, please contact us.
legal.acceptanceBody: By using BreathCalm, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the application.
legal.medicalWarning: If you feel intense dizziness, extreme chest tightness, or any concerning physical symptoms during the exercise, stop immediately and seek medical help.
legal.allowedUseBody: This is a free tool intended for personal well-being. Resale or commercial use without prior authorization is not allowed.
legal.limitLiabilityBody: BreatheCalm is not responsible for decisions made by the user based on the use of the application.
legal.cookieBody: We use local storage to save your progress and anonymous cookies to improve your experience.
legal.privacyConsent: I accept the Privacy Policy and the processing of my data to receive calm guides.
